label: campaign AC-3b.4 (a)
description: Campaign spec §6 row 1 / §8 AC-4 (a). The owner A reads the shipped `orchestrate-delivery` skill and is handed a three-chapter objective whose spec sits in the repo (chapter 2 consumes what chapter 1 produces, chapter 3 consumes both). Phase 1 must declare ONE campaign with the three chapters and their `consumes`/`produces` tokens, detail ONLY the next chapter to steps (rolling wave), and create that chapter's mission bound to the campaign and its chapter. Chapters 2 and 3 stay coarse: no mission yet. The operator's confirmation of the end is part of the prompt, and dispatch is out of scope for the turn.

This sandbox cannot dispatch. Do Phase 1 only (declare the delivery); write no packet and link no session. Start the orchestration now.
